subject: Final POC readout — go/no-go cadence and purchasing runway
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@nimblehealth.com>, Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed POC success criteria

Hi Lena / Tom — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today’s demo and the items we agreed to close out before the POC kickoff:

1) Success criteria (draft) — agreed to measure across three axes: latency (p50 < 250ms for 1kQPS simulated), extraction accuracy (entity F1 > 0.86 vs your golden set), and cost per 1k tokens (target < $0.20).
2) Scope — ingest pipeline for 3 source systems (EHR exports, support chat, claims CSV).
3) Timeline — 4-week POC: week 0 onboarding, week 1 baseline run, weeks 2–3 validation and edge-case sweeps, week 4 final readout and exec decision.
4) Owners — NimbleHealth: Lena (product) / Tom (engineering). Redwood: Jonas (SE lead), Marissa (CS).

Attached: POC_Readout_Slides_v3.pdf (slide deck we walked through). I’ve also attached a one-page MutualActionPlan_NH.xlsx to capture milestones.

Next steps I propose:
- Lena/Tom: confirm or tweak success criteria by Wed 9/22 EOD.
- Redwood: draft SOW and runbook for your procurement by Fri 9/24.
- Sync cadence: weekly 30-min ops check-ins on Mondays, and a final exec readout week of 9/27 (we’ll propose slots).

If you want us to tighten the latency SLA for particular endpoints, say which ones and we’ll re-benchmark.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment(s): POC_Readout_Slides_v3.pdf, MutualActionPlan_NH.xlsx

From: Lena Park <lena.park@nimblehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed POC success criteria

Jonas — thanks for the clear notes and the deck. Quick responses from our side:

- Success criteria: agree to the three axes. Two small changes: prefer p95 < 400ms as a user-facing SLA for the clinical extractor endpoint, and add a stability measure (no more than 3 failures per 10k requests during validation).
- Timeline: 4-week cadence works but can we shift the final readout window to the week of 9/27 (we have executive availability that week).
- Procurement: I’ll loop in procurement (procurement@nimblehealth.com) after we have a redlined SOW.

We’ll confirm the success criteria formally by Wed 9/22 EOD. If Redwood can provide a short appendix to the MAP that maps each success metric to a test plan, that would be helpful.

Best,
Lena
Product Lead, Integrations | NimbleHealth
Lena.Park@nimblehealth.com
